主要内容: On December 16, 2015, the Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note outlining the steps to implement the monetary policy stance announced by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The Board of Governors voted unanimously to raise the interest rate paid on required and excess reserve balances to 0.50 percent, effective December 17, 2015. The FOMC also authorized the Open Market Desk at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York to execute transactions in the System Open Market Account to maintain the federal funds rate within a target range of 1/4 to 1/2 percent. This included overnight and term reverse repurchase operations, as well as dollar roll and coupon swap transactions. Additionally, the Board approved a 1/4 percentage point increase in the discount rate to 1.00 percent, effective December 17, 2015. The Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note on December 16, 2015, outlining the steps for the implementation of the new monetary policy framework. This note was part of the broader effort to transition from the previous policy framework to a more flexible approach that allows for a greater emphasis on employment and inflation. The note provided guidance on how the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) would communicate its policy decisions and the implications of these decisions for the economy. The Implementation Note was a key document in the Fed's communication strategy, aimed at improving transparency and clarity in its monetary policy decisions. The note was released in the context of a period of low inflation and a strong labor market, which influenced the Fed's approach to interest rate policy and forward guidance.

股票实体.名称: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
